# unifi_wan (Data Source)

Retrieves a WAN interface via the UniFi **Official API** (`integration/v1`). WAN interfaces are read-only on the Official API. Requires a controller running version 10.1.78 or later with API-key authentication.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "unifi_wan" "primary" {
  id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The UUID of the WAN interface to look up.

### Optional

- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site to query. If not specified, the provider's default site is used.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) The name of the WAN interface.
